figura.docs.globals.extura: The Extura object that contains some random stuff. Only visible if it's enabled in the settings.
figura.docs.globals.add_script:
(Extura) Allows you to add, edit or remove scripts from your avatar.
Accepts 2 strings, if the second string is nil, the script is unloaded. If true is provided as a third argument, an error will be thrown if the script path doesn't already exist. Note this will NOT remove events
figura.docs.globals.get_scripts: (Extura) Returns a table of script names.
figura.docs.globals.get_script: (Extura) Returns the contents of a script or nil if the script doesn't exist.
figura.config.use_secure_cloud.tooltip: Whether to use a Secure Connection for the cloud
figura.config.per_instance_config.toolti: If enabled, will pull from config folder, if disabled will pull from Figura folder
figura.docs.world.get_spawn_point: (Extura) Returns a vector with the coordinates of the world spawn
figura.docs.world.isChunkLoaded: (Extura) Returns whether a chunk is loaded at the given block position
figura.docs.world.get_nearby_entities: (Extura) Returns entities near the given block position
figura.docs.world.raycast_entity: (Extura > linetraceEntity) Returns the entity and pos of a linetrace.
figura.docs.world.get_all_entities: (Extura) Returns all entities currently loaded on your client
figura.docs.world.raycast_block: (Extura > linetraceBlock) Returns the block, side, and pos of a linetrace
figura.docs.itemstack.get_food_propertie: (Extura) Returns a table of an item's food properties. If the item is not edible, an empty table is returned
figura.docs.world.linetraceBlock: (Extura) Returns the block, side, and pos of a linetrace
figura.docs.world.linetraceEntity: (Extura) Returns the entity and pos of a linetrace
figura.config.helper_errors.tooltip: Enables the game throwing errors for extra things to help preventing confusing errors later
figura.config.get_blocks_limit.tooltip: Toggles if scripts can bypass the 8 block limit of world.getBlocks
figura.config.get_target_limit.tooltip: Toggles if scripts can bypass the 20 block limit of entity.getTargetedBlock and entity.getTargetedEntity
figura.config.use_global_scripts.tooltip: Toggles if scripts are loaded from the `global_scripts` directory in your Figura folder. Note that they can override normal scripts if they have the same path/name
figura.config.use_mc_host_resolver.toolt: Toggles if Minecraft's host resolver is used. Normal Figura uses this. Disabling this will allow ports and subdirs to be used
figura.docs.avatar.set_nbt:
(Extura) Set nbt of object at the path
* First argument is a table representing the path e.g `{'path','to','meow'}`
* Second argument is the object to replace with
* Third argument is the type, use this if you need a specific type
Valid types are: float, int, short, double, string, bool, boolean, bytearray, null, nil
figura.docs.avatar.get_size_limit: (Extura) Get the size limit of the avatar from the backend
figura.docs.extura.allow_extura_cheats:
(Extura) Returns whether functions like host:setVelocity will work.
 Returns true if on a local server, permission level is above 2 or player has an objective named 'extura_can_cheat'
figura.docs.extura.upload_avatar_to: (Extura) Uploads your current avatar to FSB, Backend or both depending on supplied bools. First argument is for uploading to backend, second is for uploading to FSB. If both are false, it'll try to upload to FSB, then backend if unable to
figura.docs.extura.upload_avatar: (Extura) Uploads your current avatar to the backend and then reloads it
figura.docs.extura.reload_avatar: (Extura) Reloads the avatar of the entity UUID provided. If no UUID is provided then it'll reload your avatar
figura.docs.extura.load_local_avatar: (Extura) Loads the avatar from the specified path. If no path is provided, current avatar is unloaded.
figura.docs.extura.set_player_movement: (Extura) Set if the player can move normally
figura.docs.extura.get_player_movement: (Extura) Get if the player can move normally
figura.docs.extura.start_riding:
(Extura - Requires extura.allowExturaCheats() to be true) Force the player to ride a vehicle
* First argument is the entity to ride, if nil is provided then player will dismount instead
figura.docs.extura.override_player_movem:
(Extura) Lock a specific input to a state,
* first argument is the input('up', 'down', 'left', 'right', 'jump', or 'shift')
* second argument is the state, true, false or nil to unlock
figura.docs.extura.set_velocity: (Extura - Requires extura.allowExturaCheats() to be true) Sets the player's velocity
figura.docs.extura.set_position: (Extura - Requires extura.allowExturaCheats() to be true) Sets the player's position
figura.docs.extura.set_natural_forces: (Extura - Requires extura.allowExturaCheats() to be true) Sets if the player is effected by gravity and drag
figura.docs.extura.set_gravity: (Extura - Requires extura.allowExturaCheats() to be true) Sets if the player is effected by gravity
figura.docs.extura.set_no_physics: (Extura - Requires extura.allowExturaCheats() to be true) If false, no physics calculations will take place
figura.docs.extura.set_bind_pressed:
(Extura) Triggers a control bind. Allows running unbound binds, but may not work for modded binds. 
* First argument is the id for the bind. 
* Second argument may be a boolean for the state - many binds don't require this, and most that do will need it set at least every tick.
figura.docs.extura.get_key_mappings:
(Extura) Returns a table containing all available key mappings
Each keymapping is indexed by its id
figura.docs.extura.set_shader_pack_name: (Extura) Sets the currently selected shader pack, an empty value will select the internal shader
figura.docs.extura.first_person_model_se: (Extura) Sets whether First Person Model is currently enabled
figura.docs.extura.set_sensitivity: (Extura) Sets your sensitivity through your sensitivity option
figura.docs.client.get_mod_version: (Extura) Get the Version of a mod as a string. Returns an null if mod isn't loaded
figura.docs.client.get_mod_name: (Extura) Gets the name of a mod as a string. Returns an empty string if the mod isn't loaded
figura.docs.client.get_uuid_from_player: (Extura) Returns the UUID of a player from their name
figura.docs.client.ping_rate_limit: (Extura) Returns the amount of pings you can send in a second
figura.docs.client.ping_size_limit: (Extura) Returns the max size of a ping
figura.docs.client.is_backend_connected: (Extura) Returns true if using backend is connected. Will NOT be effected by FSB
figura.docs.client.get_current_backend:
(Extura) Returns the current IP being used for the backend, the ip to the server if using FSB or an empty string if not connected at all.
* if true, ignores FSB
figura.docs.client.is_integrated_server: (Extura) Returns if the client is on it's integrated server
figura.docs.client.get_bossbars:
Returns a table of bossbars.
Indexed by the bar's UUID, and contains the bossbar's name (JSON formatted), (lerped) progress, color, style, and whether the bar causes fog, darkens the screen, and causes music
figura.docs.client.first_person_model_en: (Extura) Gets whether First Person Model is currently enabled
figura.docs.client.first_person_model_is: (Extura) Gets whether First Person Model is currently rendering - only useful in a RENDER event
figura.docs.client.regex_find: (Extura) Checks a string against a (Java flavor) Regular Expression and returns true if any matches are found
figura.docs.client.regex_match: (Extura) Matches a string against a (Java flavor) Regular Expression and returns all matches
figura.docs.client.regex_replace: (Extura) Matches a string against a (Java flavor) Regular Expression and replaces all matches with a specified string
figura.docs.player.get_destroy_speed: (Extura) Returns the player's destroy speed for a specific block
figura.docs.player.has_correct_tool_for_: (Extura) Returns if the player's tool can get drops from a specific block
figura.docs.player.can_harm_player: (Extura) Returns if the player can be harmed by the passed in player
figura.docs.player.is_using_spy_glass: (Extura) Returns if the player is using a spy glass
figura.docs.player.get_projectile: (Extura) Returns the player's current projectile for the passed in item
figura.docs.player.get_latency: (Extura) Returns the player's latency. Returns -1 if unable to get latency
figura.docs.player.get_tablist_display_n: (Extura) Returns the player's display name on the tab list
figura.docs.player.get_nameplate:
(Extura) Returns the player's nameplate text if they have one, otherwise returns null.
 First argument should be the nameplate type(LIST, CHAT, ENTITY)
figura.docs.living_entity.get_nameplate:
(Extura) Returns the entity's nameplate text if they have one, otherwise returns null.
 First argument should be the nameplate type(LIST, CHAT, ENTITY)
figura.docs.entity.get_supporting_block_: (Extura) Returns the position of the block supporting the entity

figura.docs.extura.async_lua_function: Runs specified lua function in a thread. NOTE: VERY UNSTABLE!
figura.docs.extura.httpGet: Makes an http request to a url

figura.docs.events.upload:
(Extura) Runs before your avatar is uploaded(Note it's run 3 times).
Argument 1 is where it's currently uploading to as a string. "BOTH", "FSB" second then "BACKEND"
Argument 2 is true if uploading to backend
Argument 2 is true if uploading to fsb
Return true to cancel uploading to whatever is currently being uploaded to.
No NBT edits after the 'BOTH' event call will be uploaded
Return true to cancel upload
figura.docs.events.pre_render:
Runs at the HEAD of Minecraft's render function.
Argument 1 is a number between 0 to 1 for the delta between last tick and the next tick
Argument 2 is a string with the name of the source of this render event (See /figura docs enums render_modes)
figura.docs.events.file_drop:
(Extura) Runs whenever a file is dropped into the game window.
Argument 1 is a table of all dropped in files as input streams. These streams are closed after the event is finished.
Return true to prevent the game from attempting to do anything with the dropped files
